about: Solar's environment texture library, converted by tools/import_textures.py. CC0 output (textures/env) is committed; commercial output (textures/env_local) is git-ignored and must never be committed. Each set: albedo.png (sRGB), normal.png (OpenGL), orm.png (R AO, G rough, B metal), height.png. Each terrain layer (but the glow slots) also has maps/<set or slot>_{normal,orm,height}.png at the layer size, named on its palette line.
